name: chrome-devtools
title_zh: 用 Chrome DevTools 远程调试网页并自
tagline_zh: 调试卡住的页面、抓网络请求、看性能瓶颈，不用手动开 DevTools。适合排查线上问题、跑自动化测试、分析前端性能。
tagline_en: Debug stuck pages, inspect network, spot performance issues—without manually opening DevTools. Ideal for live.
desc_en: Uses Chrome DevTools via MCP for efficient debugging, troubleshooting and browser automation. Use when debugging web pages, automating browser interactions, analyzing performance, or inspecting network requests.
why_zh: 通过 MCP 协议把 DevTools 能力变成可调用的工具，让 AI 能直接操作浏览器。
why_en: Exposes DevTools as callable tools via MCP, letting AI drive the browser directly—no more manual clicking or copy-paste between.
limit_zh: 需要本机已安装 Chrome 并开启远程调试端口；只覆盖 Chromium 系浏览器，Firefox/Safari 不。
limit_en: Requires Chrome with remote debugging enabled; Chromium-only, no Firefox/Safari; outputs debug results or logs, not test reports.
